Meerdere spelers twijfelden zichtbaar of ze moesten uitstappen of juist moesten terugvallen. Uit precies zo’n situatie ontstond uiteindelijk de corner waaruit Tunesië de aansluitingstreffer wist te maken. Conclusie Van alle mogelijke tegenstanders lijkt Marokko voor Nederland tactisch misschien wel de lastigste. Wanneer de Marokkanen het dominante balbezitspel van dit WK weten te combineren met de compacte verdedigende organisatie die hen tijdens het WK van 2022 zo sterk maakte, krijgt Oranje een bijzonder lastige avond. Vooral de manier waarop Marokko numerieke overtallen creëert, voortdurend van positie wisselt en spelers tussen de linies vrij probeert te spelen, sluit aan bij de kwetsbaarheden die Nederland in de groepsfase meerdere keren heeft laten zien. Daar staat tegenover dat ook Marokko niet onkwetsbaar is. Wanneer Nederland erin slaagt de eerste pressinglijn te omspelen en optimaal gebruikmaakt van de ruimtes achter de hoog doorschuivende backs, liggen er zeker mogelijkheden in de omschakeling. Toch zal Oranje vooral zonder bal een vrijwel perfecte wedstrijd moeten spelen om controle te houden over de dynamische veldbezetting van Marokko. Op basis van de tot nu toe getoonde prestaties lijkt Marokko daarom eerder een zeer gelijkwaardige tegenstander dan een ploeg waar Nederland als uitgesproken favoriet aan begint. LL ontdekte zijn fascinatie voor de inhoudelijke en tactische kant van het voetbal dankzij de vernieuwende ideeën van Thomas Tuchel bij Mainz. In de regio rond de Narrenstad deed hij al ervaring op binnen zowel het amateurvoetbal als de jeugdopleidingen van profclubs Vooruitblik op Marokko Marokko speelt op dit WK vanuit een 1-4-2-3-1, met een duidelijk aanvallend gekozen benadering. In de opbouw ontstaat met Mazraoui als linksback een asymmetrische driemanslijn. Die lijn positioneert zich vrij dicht bij elkaar, terwijl Hakimi een soort vrije rol krijgt doordat hij hoger doorschuift of juist naar binnen komt. Met zijn lange loopacties in de diepte zorgt hij voor veel dreiging. Door de hoge positie van Hakimi kan Brahim Díaz lager aan de flank komen, of juist ver naar binnen bewegen om als verbindingsspeler tussen de linies te fungeren. De twee beweeglijke controleurs vormen een compacte dubbele zes en creëren zo een soort 1-4-2-opbouw. Ze bewegen goed getimed kort horizontaal richting de flank, maken elkaar daarbij vrij en proberen het drukzetten van de tegenstander uit te lokken om daar vervolgens met korte combinaties onderuit te spelen. Aan de linkerkant beweegt El Khannouss eveneens wat lager, zodat hij aanspeelbaar blijft voor de naar binnen gekomen Mazraoui. Hij kan ook naar binnen bewegen om zo direct mogelijk in de halfspace open te draaien richting het doel. Tegen Haïti speelde Saibari in de laatste groepswedstrijd als nominale tien. In de andere wedstrijden fungeerde hij vaker als spits vóór Ounahi, die aan beide kanten dominant als verbindingsspeler aanwezig was. Saibari, als krachtige en dynamische loper in de diepte én als uitzakkende spits, stelt iedere verdediging ter wereld voor problemen. Tegen man-georiënteerde pressing, zoals Haïti bijvoorbeeld in de hoge pressing met een simpele man-tegen-man-aanpak deed, vormt de Marokkaanse structuur zich vaak richting een 1-4-2-2-2. Daarbij wordt de breedte op de hoogste lijn bezet, terwijl de tienruimte wordt overbelast en de centrale verdedigers van de tegenstander theoretisch zonder directe tegenstander op hun eigen lijn staan. Deze veelgebruikte structuur zal ook voor Nederland in zijn man-tegen-man-aanpak een uitdaging vormen. Ook buiten de lage opbouw gebruikt Marokko uitzakkende spitsen en dus korte passafstanden en overtal rond een flankspeler. Dat is eigenlijk simpelweg een voortzetting van de lokkende overtalopbouw. Tijdens de overgang naar voren, richting het laatste derde, schuiven de tienen en spitsen weer door naar de hoogste lijn. Verbeterpotentieel laat Marokko vooral zien in de manier waarop het in het overgangsspel deze doorschuivende bewegingen aan de laatste verdedigingslijn van de tegenstander beter kan verbinden en met passes kan benutten. Tegen Haïti lukte dat nog niet goed genoeg. Als Nederland in het middenblok opnieuw prioriteit geeft aan het afdekken van de diepte achter de laatste lijn, dus niet met beide centrale verdedigers en backs doordekt, maar tegelijkertijd wel man-tegen-man druk wil zetten, zal Oranje waarschijnlijk voortdurend achteruit moeten verdedigen tegen Marokkaanse spelers die in de tussenruimte vrij kunnen opendraaien. Als de Marokkanen, die de flank zeer goed getimed vrijspelen en overbelasten — iets wat juist bijzonder ongunstig is voor Nederland, zoals in de vorige wedstrijden meerdere keren zichtbaar werd — er vervolgens in slagen om directer de doorschuivende bewegingen aan de laatste lijn van de tegenstander te vinden, kunnen ze Oranje tussen de linies volledig uit elkaar spelen. Nog gevaarlijker wordt het wanneer Marokko aan de flank of in de halfspace een ruit vormt. Binnen die structuur beweegt voortdurend een vijfde speler vrij. De speler aan de punt van de ruit zoekt met een loopactie de diepte om bijvoorbeeld de centrale verdediger en back te binden. Tegelijkertijd houdt de buitenspeler maximale breedte of komt hij juist in de bal om zijn directe tegenstander uit positie te trekken. De binnenste speler fungeert als verbindingsspeler, zodat het spel eenvoudig terug richting het centrum kan worden verlegd. De vijfde speler beweegt vervolgens precies in de ruimte die daardoor vrijkomt. Op die manier weet Marokko zich regelmatig vrij te spelen aan de flank. Van daaruit kunnen de spelers open draaien en optimaal gebruikmaken van de diagonale passlijnen die ontstaan. Dat maakt deze veldbezetting extra gevaarlijk, omdat de ploeg beschikt over meerdere creatieve dribbelaars die ook individueel een tegenstander kunnen uitspelen. Een nog groter probleem voor Oranje is dat Marokko aan beide kanten met een naar binnen gedraaide voet opbouwt. Aan de linkerkant gebeurt dat via El Khannouss en Mazraoui, aan de rechterkant via Brahim Díaz. Slaagt Nederland er met de eerste pressinglijn – en dan vooral met Gakpo en Malen – niet in om op tijd een 2-tegen-1 te creëren tegen Díaz en El Khannouss, dan dreigt het numerieke ondertal in het centrum de verdediging te dwingen tot slecht getimede uitstapmomenten vanuit de laatste lijn. Gebeurt dat niet, dan bestaat het risico dat Marokko simpelweg door het centrum combineert. Kiest Oranje juist voor meer ondersteuning aan de buitenkant om daar de 2-tegen-1-situaties op te lossen, dan zullen de Marokkanen dankzij hun korte passafstanden, het constante overtal in de opbouw en hun bijzonder loopsterke dubbele zes nauwelijks onder druk komen te staan. Ook het Nederlandse principe om het spel bewust van buiten naar binnen te sturen, lijkt tegen deze tegenstander eerder een nadeel dan een voordeel. De centrale kwaliteiten van Marokko, gecombineerd met de positie van Mazraoui en zijn sterke rechtervoet, sluiten daar juist uitstekend op aan. Het voortdurend uitlokken van uitstappende verdedigers, de vele overtal­situaties, de creatieve dribbelaars, de goed uitgevoerde patronen richting de flank, de constante positiewisselingen en het gebruik van spelers met een naar binnen gedraaide voet maken Marokko tot een bijzonder lastige tegenstander voor de Nederlandse defensieve organisatie. Op dat vlak zal Oranje zich waarschijnlijk moeten aanpassen. Verdedigend Verdedigend speelt Marokko meestal vanuit een ruimtegeoriënteerd 1-4-4-2, waarbij de nummer tien naast de spits komt te spelen. Tegen Brazilië probeerden de Marokkanen de Braziliaanse opbouw bewust naar hun linkerflank te sturen. Saibari positioneerde zich daarvoor aan de rechterkant hoger tegen de linker centrale verdediger van Brazilië. Mogelijk kiezen ze tegen Nederland voor dezelfde aanpak, om Van Dijk minder opbouwopties te geven. Binnen het 1-4-4-2 verdedigt de middenlinie vooral ruimtegeoriënteerd en veel minder vanuit mandekking. Regelmatig speelt Marokko daarbij op de grens van verticale oncompactheid, met name wanneer één of beide controleurs in het drukmoment moeten doordekken. De buitenspelers, Díaz en El Khannouss, kiezen juist voor bredere uitgangsposities om direct druk te kunnen zetten aan de flank. Marokko onderscheidt zich de afgelopen jaren vooral door zijn defensieve intensiteit. Counterpress, sprints naar de bal, agressief doorstappen en het ondersteunen van ploeggenoten gebeuren allemaal op een hoog niveau. In combinatie met de bredere positie van de buitenspelers ontstaan daardoor kleine pressingvallen tussen de buitenspeler en de dubbele zes. Of dat volledig bewust gebeurt of niet, maakt uiteindelijk weinig uit: tegen Marokko krijg je meestal nauwelijks tijd of ruimte aan de bal. Toch kent ook deze manier van verdedigen zwakke punten. Bij het afschermen van de controleursruimte verdedigt Marokko niet altijd compact. Mazraoui stuurt El Khannouss regelmatig naar de zijkant om te voorkomen dat hij te veel ruimte moet verdedigen. Bij tweede ballen ontstaan daardoor geregeld grote gaten. Daarnaast zet de voorste lijn relatief weinig directe druk op de bal. De nadruk ligt vooral op het afsluiten van passlijnen en het sturen van de opbouw. Voor Oranje liggen daar zeker mogelijkheden, mits het de juiste pressingtriggers van Marokko weet te herkennen en te bespelen. Het overspelen van de eerste pressinglijn zou voor Nederland geen groot probleem moeten zijn. Daarna zal Oranje vooral moeten proberen de relatief zwakke linkerflank én de centrale verdedigers van Marokko aan het twijfelen te brengen: stappen ze uit of blijven ze juist staan? Wanneer Marokko hoger druk zet, kunnen lange ballen bovendien een effectief wapen zijn. Ook Haïti kwam op die manier tot doelpunten. De laatste lijn van Marokko laat zich namelijk al vroeg terugzakken, terwijl de balnabije backs en de middenlinie – door het beperkte drukniveau op de bal – ver moeten uitstappen om hun directe tegenstander onder druk te krijgen. Daar staat tegenover dat Marokko tegen Haïti ook een goede tactische aanpassing liet zien met een sturend 1-3-1-4-2. De grootste kwetsbaarheid van Marokko ligt echter in het gedrag van de balverre spelers na balverlies. Zij leveren zowel in de counterpress als in het terugverdedigen nauwelijks ondersteuning. Dat valt vooral op aan de rechterkant wanneer Hakimi hoog op het veld staat. Kanttekening Mocht Marokko er tijdens grote delen van de wedstrijd toch voor kiezen om terug te grijpen op de speelwijze uit het tijdperk van Regragui en te verdedigen vanuit een extreem compact en intensief 1-4-1-4-1- of 1-5-4-1-blok, dan wordt het voor Nederland bijzonder lastig om kwalitatief goede kansen te creëren. In het slechtste geval zorgt de zwakke counterpress van Oranje ervoor dat het onvoldoende dominantie kan ontwikkelen om Marokko langdurig op eigen helft vast te zetten. Daardoor zal Nederland minder tijd en balbezit rond het Marokkaanse strafschopgebied hebben en simpelweg te weinig kansen creëren om op basis van volume tot doelpunten te komen. Conclusie Voor Nederland is Marokko misschien wel de meest ongunstige tegenstander die het op dit WK kan treffen. Wanneer Marokko het dominante balbezitspel van het WK 2026 weet te combineren met het compacte lage blok waarmee het op het WK van 2022 zoveel succes had, Saibari als spits opstelt en Bouaddi de voorkeur krijgt boven Amrabat, dan is Oranje vanuit tactisch oogpunt eerder de underdog dan de favoriet. In dat scenario lijkt uitschakeling waarschijnlijker dan plaatsing voor de volgende ronde. HH groeide op vlak bij de Nederlands-Duitse grens, maar liet zich voetbaltactisch vooral inspireren door Zuid-Europa. Naast zijn werkzaamheden als freelancer voor Duitse profclubs is hij sinds twee jaar actief als jeugdtrainer van de O17 van N.E.C. Nijmegen. Artikel von Next Generation Wir rebooten Spielverlagerung. Unter der "Next Generation" veröffentlichen unsere neuen Autoren, Analysten und Trainer ihren Output. Einige von ihnen haben bereits Erfahrungen gesammelt, andere machen ihre ersten Schritte beim Erstellen von Artikeln. Nicht alle Beiträge werden schon ausgereift sein, aber zur Weiterentwicklung ihrer Verfasser finden wir es sehr wichtig, dass auch sie öffentlich verfügbar sind, um den Austausch und die Diskussion zu ermöglichen, die die Autoren weiterbringen. Daher möchten wir dafür werben, die Texte der "Next Generation" als Entwicklungsprojekt zu verstehen und am Prozessgedanken zu messen. Einige Artikel sind bereits auf dem Level, auf der Startseite von Spielverlagerung erscheinen zu können. Eine Übersicht sämtlicher Artikel der "Next Generation" findet sich hier.

It has been revealed that hoewel Nederland met een hoge laatste lijn en veel spelers rond de bal in theorie uitstekende voorwaarden creëert voor een effectieve counterpress, blijft de uitvoering wisselvallig. Na balverlies ontbreekt het nog te vaak aan directe druk op de bal. Daardoor krijgt de tegenstander regelmatig de mogelijkheid om de eerste pass vooruit te spelen voordat Nederland de controle terug heeft. Een deel van dat probleem ontstaat al tijdens het eigen balbezit. Wanneer Nederland te snel door het centrum probeert te spelen zonder eerst voldoende tegenstanders te binden, ligt de ruimte na balverlies direct open. Tunesië wist daar meerdere keren gebruik van te maken door met een numeriek overtal uit de eerste druk weg te spelen. Ook de restverdediging oogde niet altijd even stabiel. Doordat De Jong regelmatig uitzakte naast of tussen de centrale verdedigers, ontstond er soms een 4-0-structuur vóór de laatste lijn. De ruimte vóór de verdediging bleef daardoor onbezet, waardoor Tunesië na balveroveringen relatief eenvoudig de eerste pass kon versturen. Aké probeerde dat meerdere keren individueel te corrigeren door agressief door te stappen vanuit de laatste lijn. Zijn proactieve manier van verdedigen leverde verschillende balveroveringen op, maar bracht ook risico’s met zich mee. In de twaalfde minuut ontstond juist door zo’n uitstapmoment ruimte aan de buitenkant, waardoor Tunesië gevaarlijk kon omschakelen. Vergeleken met Van de Ven verdedigt Aké duidelijk aanvallender. Hij stapt sneller uit, durft vaker initiatief te nemen en wint veel duels vooruit. Tegelijkertijd vraagt die speelstijl om een perfecte onderlinge afstemming binnen de restverdediging.

Sources indicate that na rust verloor de counterpress geleidelijk aan kwaliteit. De afstanden tussen de spelers werden groter, waardoor het collectieve karakter steeds meer verdween. In plaats van gezamenlijk druk te zetten, probeerden individuele spelers het balverlies op eigen kracht te herstellen. Daardoor werd de restorganisatie minder stabiel en kreeg Tunesië vaker de mogelijkheid om onder de eerste druk uit te spelen. Ook de communicatie bij het doordekken liet in die fase te wensen over. Meerdere spelers twijfelden zichtbaar of ze moesten uitstappen of juist moesten terugvallen. Uit precies zo’n situatie ontstond uiteindelijk de corner waaruit Tunesië de aansluitingstreffer wist te maken.

In combinatie met de bredere positie van de buitenspelers ontstaan daardoor kleine pressingvallen tussen de buitenspeler en de dubbele zes. Of dat volledig bewust gebeurt of niet, maakt uiteindelijk weinig uit: tegen Marokko krijg je meestal nauwelijks tijd of ruimte aan de bal. Toch kent ook deze manier van verdedigen zwakke punten. Bij het afschermen van de controleursruimte verdedigt Marokko niet altijd compact. Mazraoui stuurt El Khannouss regelmatig naar de zijkant om te voorkomen dat hij te veel ruimte moet verdedigen. Bij tweede ballen ontstaan daardoor geregeld grote gaten. Daarnaast zet de voorste lijn relatief weinig directe druk op de bal. De nadruk ligt vooral op het afsluiten van passlijnen en het sturen van de opbouw. Voor Oranje liggen daar zeker mogelijkheden, mits het de juiste pressingtriggers van Marokko weet te herkennen en te bespelen. Het overspelen van de eerste pressinglijn zou voor Nederland geen groot probleem moeten zijn. Daarna zal Oranje vooral moeten proberen de relatief zwakke linkerflank én de centrale verdedigers van Marokko aan het twijfelen te brengen: stappen ze uit of blijven ze juist staan?

Wanneer Marokko hoger druk zet, kunnen lange ballen bovendien een effectief wapen zijn. Ook Haïti kwam op die manier tot doelpunten. De laatste lijn van Marokko laat zich namelijk al vroeg terugzakken, terwijl de balnabije backs en de middenlinie – door het beperkte drukniveau op de bal – ver moeten uitstappen om hun directe tegenstander onder druk te krijgen. Daar staat tegenover dat Marokko tegen Haïti ook een goede tactische aanpassing liet zien met een sturend 1-3-1-4-2. De grootste kwetsbaarheid van Marokko ligt echter in het gedrag van de balverre spelers na balverlies. Zij leveren zowel in de counterpress als in het terugverdedigen nauwelijks ondersteuning. Dat valt vooral op aan de rechterkant wanneer Hakimi hoog op het veld staat.

Recent findings suggest that mocht Marokko er tijdens grote delen van de wedstrijd toch voor kiezen om terug te grijpen op de speelwijze uit het tijdperk van Regragui en te verdedigen vanuit een extreem compact en intensief 1-4-1-4-1- of 1-5-4-1-blok, dan wordt het voor Nederland bijzonder lastig om kwalitatief goede kansen te creëren. In het slechtste geval zorgt de zwakke counterpress van Oranje ervoor dat het onvoldoende dominantie kan ontwikkelen om Marokko langdurig op eigen helft vast te zetten. Daardoor zal Nederland minder tijd en balbezit rond het Marokkaanse strafschopgebied hebben en simpelweg te weinig kansen creëren om op basis van volume tot doelpunten te komen.

Recent findings suggest that voor Nederland is Marokko misschien wel de meest ongunstige tegenstander die het op dit WK kan treffen. Wanneer Marokko het dominante balbezitspel van het WK 2026 weet te combineren met het compacte lage blok waarmee het op het WK van 2022 zoveel succes had, Saibari als spits opstelt en Bouaddi de voorkeur krijgt boven Amrabat, dan is Oranje vanuit tactisch oogpunt eerder de underdog dan de favoriet. In dat scenario lijkt uitschakeling waarschijnlijker dan plaatsing voor de volgende ronde.

HH groeide op vlak bij de Nederlands-Duitse grens, maar liet zich voetbaltactisch vooral inspireren door Zuid-Europa. Naast zijn werkzaamheden als freelancer voor Duitse profclubs is hij sinds twee jaar actief als jeugdtrainer van de O17 van N.E.C. Nijmegen.

Né à Firminy, conseiller municipal de Saint-Etienne (depuis 8 mois) et parlementaire le plus investi dans le soutien aux ultras stéphanois (il avait été un des premiers signataires de notre pétition lancée le printemps 2025 et ayant recueilli plus de 5 800 signatures), le député PS ligérien Pierrick Courbon (41 ans) a posté cet après-midi le message suivant sur son compte Instagram.

"Ce qui s'est passé à Reims est inacceptable ! Les supporters ne sont pas des sous-citoyens, encore moins du bétail. Je saisis le Ministre de l'Intérieur. Malgré trois décisions de justice confirmant l'absence d'interdiction d'accès au stade tout comme les déplacements en autocars, les supporters stéphanois ont été interpellés à proximité du stade Auguste-Delaune, et contraints de faire demi-tour sous escorte policière. Il est indéniable que des erreurs ont été commises par les services de l'Etat, et qu'un contournement des décisions de justice a eu lieu.

Les supporters ne sont pas des sous-citoyens. Pourtant, depuis de nombreuses années, le supportérisme est un laboratoire commode de mesures sécuritaires et liberticides, qui ne seraient toélérées dans un autre pan de la société. Comme je m'y suis engagé dès samedi, je viens d'alerter Laurent Nunez pour demander des réponses et des explications. La gestion des supporters en France est catastrophique. Je continuerai de les défendre car l'enjeu dépasse le simple cadre sportif.".

  • Ce sont les Sanpriods qui ont ouvert la marque, contre le cours du jeu, à la 19ème minute sur une approximation défensive.
  • La composition : Clapeyron - Bergougnoux, Wojcik, Bastide, Uneau - Boukerma, Lebreton (L.La Rosa, 45ème), M.La Rosa (Linganzi Koumba, 40ème) - Fernandes (Moutae, 50ème), Bangoura, Davignon.

Les U15 de Benjamin Petit, après leur précieuse victoire d'il y a deux semaines contre Villefranche (1-0) se déplaçaient cet après-midi sur le terrain de l'AS Saint-Priest, qui n'est jamais un adversaire facile. Auparavant, dans la semaine, mercredi, à Cruas, ils s'étaient mesurés à l'Olympique de Marseille, leader de la poule Méditerranée, et qui, en match amical, a largement battu bon nombre d'équipes de renom. Les jeunes Verts avaient mieux fait que se défendre, ne s'inclinant que sur le score de 2 à 1. Revenons-en au match d'aujourd'hui pour dire que la victoire est revenue en toute logique aux jeunes Verts sur le score de 2 à 1, une victoire qui va leur permettre d'engranger des points et....de la confiance.

Ce sont les Sanpriods qui ont ouvert la marque, contre le cours du jeu, à la 19ème minute sur une approximation défensive. Mais les Verts réagissaient immédiatement et, deux minutes plus tard, à la 21ème, Kaïs Boukerma, sur une passe de Charly Davignon, de l'entrée de la surface, plaçait une frappe au ras du poteau pour l'égalisation. Un quart d'heure plus tard, à la 36ème, Hugo Bastide, qui opérait aujourd'hui en défense centrale, récupérait fort à propos un 2ème ballon sur un corner pour donner l'avantage aux Verts. Ce fut difficile après le repos, car Saint-Priest mettait la pression pour revenir au score. Mais les Verts faisaient preuve de solidarité et de rigueur défensive pour conserver cet avantage de 2 à 1.A noter la victoire des U14 sur le score de 8 à 1. Nous reviendrons ultérieurement sur la belle saison de cette équipe.

La composition : Clapeyron - Bergougnoux, Wojcik, Bastide, Uneau - Boukerma, Lebreton (L.La Rosa, 45ème), M.La Rosa (Linganzi Koumba, 40ème) - Fernandes (Moutae, 50ème), Bangoura, Davignon.

It has been revealed that la réaction de Benjamin Petit : "Nous avons fait une bonne première mi-temps, même si nous avons un peu manqué de tranchant dans le domaine offensif. Il n'a pas manqué grand chose sur plusieurs situations intéressantes. C'est là un axe de progrès bien identifié que d'aller chercher cette réussite offensive. J'ai apprécié le fait que les garçons soient restés sereins après l'ouverture du score par Saint-Priest. Cela leur a permis de revenir rapidement et de passer devant avant la pause. Par contre, la deuxième mi-temps a été plus compliquée. Saint-Priest nous a mis la pression et nous avons eu plus de mal à construire et à progresser à l'intérieur du jeu. Mais nous avons fait preuve de caractère, de rigueur défensive et cela nous a permis de conserver le résultat.".

#119684. Floyd Samba’s Man City debut double has father Chris dancing

📅 17 Sep 2026 • ⏱️ 20m • 📚 Deep Dive (4087 w)
📖 Baca
General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Co ↗ Open Full Page

Floyd Samba’s Man City debut double has father Chris dancing

📅 17 Sep 2026 | ⏱️ 20 min read (4087 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~20 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • There was very much a Samba beat to this Manchester City victory – and it almost had a famous father in the crowd up dancing.
  • This was a night when Brazilian Allan Elias scored his first goal on an enterprising first appearance for City.
  • But it was another debutant who stole the show as the Carabao Cup holders sailed past Norwich City to set up a fourth-round meeting with Brighton.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

There was very much a Samba beat to this Manchester City victory – and it almost had a famous father in the crowd up dancing.

This was a night when Brazilian Allan Elias scored his first goal on an enterprising first appearance for City.

But it was another debutant who stole the show as the Carabao Cup holders sailed past Norwich City to set up a fourth-round meeting with Brighton.

Floyd Samba scored two fine goals and had a hand in another on a dream debut that had his beaming dad up off his seat and thrusting his arms in the air as if ready to party.

If the Samba surname feels familiar, that is because Floyd’s father Christopher played more than 200 games for Blackburn Rovers, Queens Park Rangers and Aston Villa.

In fact, it was very much a family affair as Floyd’s brothers Tyrone and Emerson, who are also in City’s academy and hoping one day to tread a similar path, joined in the jubilant celebrations alongside their mother, a visibly emotional Theresa.

This particular evening belonged to Floyd, though. Deployed as a lone striker by Enzo Maresca, you would not have known he ordinarily plays as a midfielder such was the confidence and composure the 17-year-old oozed.

Norwich could not live with him or City for that matter as Maresca’s impressive start as manager since replacing Pep Guardiola continued apace.

This must have been an incredibly satisfying moment for Samba Sr. He came through incredible hardship – at one stage as a teenager he was rough-sleeping – to forge an impressive career totalling more than 450 games for club and country.

So to be in a position to now have three sons in City’s academy and one produce a debut like this will fill him with enormous pride. Floyd was later seen enjoying a warm embrace with his dad in the crowd, moments after being congratulated by Tyrone, a year his senior, and 12-year-old Emerson, who plays for City’s Under-13s.

“I knew there would be an opportunity to get some minutes for the first time with the first team – to get a debut like that is mind blowing,” Samba said. “I couldn’t believe it myself, but that’s just the beginning, I’ve got a massive career ahead of me. It was a great debut.”.

Floyd caught the eye with a fine free-kick in City’s 2-1 FA Youth Cup final victory over Manchester United last season and now he has goals for the senior side to his name. Pretty stunning they were, too.

The first was a superbly steered header past two Norwich bodies on the line from Allan’s cross and the second a lovely, nonchalantly curled finish low into the far corner.

What a moment for Floyd Samba! 😍A goal on his Man City debut for the 17-year-old, son of former Blackburn defender Chris 🩵 pic.twitter.com/VCVfX9HCNn.

Sources indicate that chris Samba has deliberately kept a low profile, keen to let his sons get on with their own careers free of distractions, but there was no chance he was going to be able to suppress his emotions in that instant. And nor should he. It was some moment for the boy and his family.

It has been revealed that as impressed as Maresca was by the goals, it will have been other elements of Samba’s game that also caught the eye. He did extremely well to hold off the attentions of Norwich’s centre-backs when receiving a pass from Ayyoub Bouaddi and then returning the ball to the Moroccan who released Rayan Cherki through to score City’s second. His movement was also sharp, at one point taking a difficult pass sweetly in an adjusted strike, only for Norwich’s Bruno Alves to come across to make a timely intervention before Samba could get his shot off.

"Was there any doubt?"Ayyoub Bouaddi with his first assist for Man City as he sets up Rayan Cherki to make it 2-0 🔵 pic.twitter.com/0gfxp5GDXy.

According to recent reports, “It was satisfying not just for the two goals but for the entire performance,” Maresca noted. “He didn’t play many games as a nine but he was good. He’s young, full of energy, strong, he can finish.”.

Sources indicate that allan, a £34m summer signing from Palmeiras, will have been just as pleased with his contribution. Maresca’s fluid formation initially resembled a 3-1-5-1 with Allan effectively operating as a right wing-back but he stuck doggedly to the task before eventually getting the moment to showcase his quality, first with his cross for Samba and later with a neat solo run and finish.

Driving inside Sam Field and then cutting back inside the Norwich man before curling an inch perfect finish into the bottom corner – all of it done with his left foot – it was quite the introduction.

Allan on his debut! 🇧🇷Magic from the Brazilian to make it 3-0 to Man City 💥 pic.twitter.com/nw6lNqh1yL.

Hugo Viana, City’s director of football, has mentioned supporters will need to be patient with Allan and that it may take the 22-year-old time to adjust to English football but this first outing will do his confidence plenty of good.

“It was key for him to play 90 minutes and to see a little bit the English competition that is a bit different from South America so overall was good,” Maresca remarked.

Recent findings suggest that cherki was the only survivor from the team that started Sunday’s victory over Manchester United but it all felt pretty seamless from City. Bouaddi, the £85m signing from Lille, was poised and graceful in midfield alongside the impressive Mateo Kovacic and Geronimo Rulli could not have asked for a much quieter debut in goal.

Sources indicate that FLOYD SAMBA again!! 🌟The 17-year-old curls one in to score his second on his Man City debut with his dad Christopher watching on in the stands 👏 pic.twitter.com/fJ5mfEWBx1.

Nico O’Reilly looked like he had barely broken a sweat despite Norwich’s players routinely being unable to keep up with him. Norwich themselves made nine changes but the gulf in class was enormous and testament to City’s strength in depth.

The game also gave Maresca the opportunity to give run outs to two more academy graduates who played in that Youth Cup final triumph, Kaden Braithwaite and Ryan McAidoo and the latter got his own name on the scoresheet to make it 5-0.

All told there were seven City academy graduates on the pitch, two of them playing for Norwich. This was certainly a night to remember for the club’s youth production line.

In a recent development, with the dominant performance, Man City have earned themselves the privilege of hosting Brighton in the next round, who will no doubt prove a much stiffer challenge than Norwich. They become the sixth all-Premier League tie in the next round, with only Fleetwood, Bradford and Peterborough remaining from outside the top flight:.

Possession: Man City 66% vs 34% Norwich.

Touches inside opposition box: 30 vs 4.

It has been revealed that erling Haaland left out of the squad, watching from the stands, would have enjoyed that performance from Floyd Samba. Here is his second goal for you to enjoy on his debut night:.

Recent findings suggest that FLOYD SAMBA again!! 🌟The 17-year-old curls one in to score his second on his Man City debut with his dad Christopher watching on in the stands 👏 pic.twitter.com/fJ5mfEWBx1.

Five unanswered goals and a home-grown hero emerges for Manchester City!

Great through ball from O’Reilly, which Lewis lets run past him for the dummy. McAidoo runs on to it on the right of the box and first-time fires it low into the far corner.

It has been a perfect night for Manchester City’s academy.

Well we look like we’re heading for a matching scoreline to the previous edition of the fixture. That pesky shot on target is still eluding Norwich, whereas Samba is still out there looking for his hat-trick.

Two minutes of time to be added – who will get there first?

O’Reilly sends a high, looping ball to the back post from the left side, where McAidoo rushes to meet it but can’t get over it under pressure.

Final change for Norwich, as Kvistgaarden who has not had much service tonight, comes off for Schwartau.

Bouaddi sends a looping ball across the field to McAidoo, which he picks up on the edge of the box, but he is unable to get the ball under control to take his shot and it is cleared away as far as another City shirt.

The corner comes in to the centre of the box but is headed out by a City shirt.

It’s all slightly too little too late for Norwich.

They get another corner as Musaba tries to send a cross into the box from the right and it is blocked out.

In a recent development, A free-kick for Norwich now as O’Reilly commits the foul 35 yards out. It goes in towards McConville at the back post, but Ait-Nouri heads it out for a Norwich corner.

Mo Touré strays just offside on the edge of the box, as Musaba sends a lovely little ball over to find him on the turn and the forward slots it past Rulli. Celebrations don’t quite begin before the flag goes up but that is a shame for the visitors.

Norwich have managed to get more of a grip in this half, despite conceding two more goals, but they are still without a shot on goal as we approach the final 15 minutes.

Another round of changes for both sides.

Man City take off scorer of their third goal Allan to bring on Braithwaite.

Norwich replace Ben Slimane and Bruno Alves with Touré and McConville.

Samba again at the heart of the action, laying off the ball to McAidoo on the right for the winger to run into the box. His shot towards the far post is saved low by Grimshaw who spills it almost into the path of Lewis, but Norwich survive.

Lewis makes a run down the right-hand side and crosses into Samba on the edge of the box. He lays off to McAidoo, but his shot goes sailing over the bar.

A surprise to no one, it is chucking it down in Manchester.

Big cheers from the away end as Norwich get their first corner of the evening. It is lofted high and long to the back post, where it is headed away by Bouaddi. It bounces out to Musaba, who has just come on, and he strikes it from the top of the box on the half-volley.

Industry observers note that his shot cuts through a crowd in the box and has Rulli diving to his left, but it goes wide of the post. What an introduction that would have been!

Industry observers note that well all the stories from this match will be all about young Floyd Samba. Feel free to leave your best punny Samba/dance-related headlines in the comments section.

For Man City as you would expect it is all about game management from here on out.

Some more changes to report for Norwich as well, as Crnac is replaced by Musaba.

Wright is able to run in to space towards the edge of the box, but as has been their story all evening, his pass out to the wing is just not where it needs to be and their effort just breaks down.

Sources indicate that what a way to score a second! A night to remember for Floyd Samba!

Norwich try and play out from the back but far too sloppy and Ait-Nouri picks up the ball on the left of the box. He has plenty of time to tee up Samba inside the box at the left corner, who finds himself with plenty of space to curl his shot into the far corner, beating the diving Grimshaw.

We may be seeing plenty more of him this season.

Norwich looking for their way back into the game, as the ball comes down the left, fizzed in low and flashes past Rulli, trying to claim it. It deflects off a crowd of bodies and spins up, but Fisher can’t connect and it spins away harmlessly wide of the goal.

It is definitely Norwich’s best chance of the game and Fisher will be upset he hasn’t made more of that.

In a recent development, and Allan makes it three! Minutes after the restart, the Brazilian makes his own mark on his debut.

Recent findings suggest that maresca switched him onto the left side to escape Yongwa, and he picks up the ball outside the box and makes the run inside. He runs circles around Field and slots the ball home into the far bottom corner.

Some changes from both sides at half-time. McAidoo comes on for Cherki, though O’Reilly is the one to move up into midfield to fill the gap.

Norwich take off Diallo for Maghoma.

45 minutes left for the visitors to create something special!

According to recent reports, what a moment for Floyd Samba! 😍A goal on his Man City debut for the 17-year-old, son of former Blackburn defender Chris 🩵 pic.twitter.com/VCVfX9HCNn.

Manchester City will be the ones to host Brighton in the next round – giving the visitors the opportunity to pull off a remarkable feat of knocking out both Manchester sides should they win.

Enjoy the highlights from last night as they came from behind to dispatch Man Utd:.

Possession: Man City 72% vs 28% Norwich.

Touches inside opposition box: 15 vs 1.

Sources indicate that and without much ado at the end of the half, we have reached the break. City put themselves in control with two quick-fire goals and it looks a tall task for Norwich to find their way back into the match.

Credit where it is due, Yongwa has been very good for Norwich. He has stood fast, made some very good challenges and stopped Allan getting much of a look-in on the right.

Industry observers note that as we approach half-time, the stats tell a sorry story. Norwich have had just 28% possession and created a single shot, none on target.

As City come again, Norwich have pulled every man back to try and keep the situation salvageable before the break.

Industry observers note that samba was in again there, making a run into the box with a ball from Cherki, wrestling with Bruno Alves as he goes. The defender does enough to throw him off and Grimshaw is able to come out and snatch the ball.

Man City are looking to close this out now, and they look threatening every time they break.

Ait-Nouri is the latest to try his luck, making a run into the box from the left, but his shot is blocked.

A few minutes to remember here for Floyd Samba. First he steers home a very well taken header to give City the lead and then he plays a crucial role in the second, holding the ball up well before laying it off to Bouaddi to release Cherki to score. That’s how to make an impression on your debut.

And the floodgates have opened. Two goals in two minutes for the defending champions.

Samba finds Bouaddi in midfield, who takes it forward and feeds Cherki running to his left. He gets himself one-on-one and slots cool as you like into the bottom left corner.

City are in control all of a sudden and Norwich will be devastated.

As soon as I say that, Floyd Samba finds a way through.

He has looked the brightest for City, and O’Reilly sends a cross over the box from the left, drawing Grimshaw away from position. The ball is pinged back in by Allan and the youngster stoops to meet it, heading in to the bottom corner.

Recent findings suggest that norwich have been very disciplined in defence so far. Yongwa has been closing down Allan on the wing very well.

Cherki is starting to get some momentum – but is swarmed by yellow shirts as he picks up the ball on the edge of the area.

Industry observers note that another loose ball from City in midfield and Norwich pick it up again. The ball to set the front line free is equally as loose from the visitors though and it breaks down once again.

Samba is looking lively, racing to get on a ball in front of Darling just on the edge of the box. Darling recovers to send it out for a corner, which becomes a free kick after Ait-Nouri wrestles his man to the ground at the back post as City are taking.

Wright sends a long ball across the field, looking for a man on the right side but Rulli is alert to it and comes to claim at the edge of the box.

Kovacic indicates some promise with a strong run on the ball down the centre of the field, taking the ball all the way to the edge of the box, where he collides with a defender, and the ball spins away for Norwich to clear out.

This is better from City, who have looked like they’re lacking drive so far.

Yongwa again probing down the left side. It takes two to dispossess him and Man City manage to get the throw in, but approaching 20 minutes Norwich will be happy with this.

Recent findings suggest that kovacic loses the ball in midfield and Norwich surge forward. The move breaks down as Wright’s pass to Diallo on the wing is just behind him and he can’t take it forward into the box.

Spent the first 10 minutes trying to work out City’s system and settled on a 3-1-5-1, with Bouaddi operating as a nominal third centre-back, but it seems to have changed again now with O’Reilly dropping to left back and Bouaddi stepping into midfield. No doubt the metamorphosis will continue.

This Man City team have never played all together and it is clear that they’re still settling in here, figuring out how they’re going to press here.

Kovacic in the captain’s armband is tying it all together in midfield.

Khusanov threads a lovely ball to Samba who flicks it into the path of Lewis, who takes it and makes a run into the box. He creates space and sends a right-footed shot over the bar – but Man City are building.

According to recent reports, norwich make a move forward, with Yongwa bringing the ball down the left side but his cross into the box is blocked by Allan sliding in. The Brazilian is then fouled again as Yongwa tries to reclaim the ball and Man City get back in possession.

Industry observers note that it’s actually three Samba brothers at City. The youngest, Emerson, is also in the academy.

Early foul on Allan gets Man City a free kick and they have started as everyone expected they would – in plenty of possession.

They look for the early goal as O’Reilly feeds him in the from the left side, but the shot is blocked.

We have kicked off in Manchester!

City will be looking to make it six straight wins across all competitions tonight, having started perfectly in the Premier League with four wins from four, and comfortably seeing off Porto in their Champions League opener.

They were the talk of the weekend with their deeply controversial 1-0 win over rivals Manchester United as – having gone down to 10 men after Phil Foden was sent off – their winning goal was allowed to stand despite Enzo Fernández being clearly in an offside position that impacted United’s keeper and backline.

Vous avez pu suivre cette rencontre en direct sur notre forum grâce à notre envoyé spécial MachuPicchu42 : les U17 ont concédé un match nul et vierge à la mi-journée face au Cavigal de Nice au Stade Georges Bereta du Centre Robert Herbin.

Dominateurs jusqu'à l'entame du dernier quart d'heure, les Verts ont eu deux grosses occasions en première période. Sur la première, le portier niçois a repoussé le tir à bout portant de Naël Dani. Sur la seconde, un défenseur visiteur a repoussé sur sa ligne une tête d'Isaak Seydi (photo).

It has been revealed that en deuxième mi-temps, Lohoré Gobé a eu à son tour une belle opportunité d'ouvrir le score mais sa tentative a été déjouée par le gardien azuréen. Isaak Seydi a de nouveau eu une occase de la tête, hélas non cadrée. Izaya Kimpioka a raté un face à face en tirant à côté. Les visteurs se sont enhardis lors de 20 dernières minutes pas très bien maîtrisées par les Stéphanois mais Andra Laugier n'aura eu aucun arrêt à faire de toute la rencontre.

L'ASSE a perdu sa 5e place au profit de son ex-club partenaire Saint-Priest, qui a cartonné 6-1 le Gazelec Ajaccio (avant-dernier), prochain adversaire des Verts (dimanche prochain en Corse).

La compo : Laugier - Tiambo (Balta, 33') - Mnemoi, Dagbo, Bufferne - Demassieux, Mendy (Thibaudat, 77'), Gobé - Seydi, Kimpioka, Dani (Aytone, 70').

It has been revealed that la réaction de David Le Moal : "On a eu la mainmise sur le match jusqu'au dernier quart d'heure. On a eu pas mal d'occasions, c'est dommage qu'on n'ait pas réussi à les convertir. En première période, on a eu du mal à passer l'adversaire dans le coeur du jeu donc on s'est évertué à contourner le bloc assez bas du Cavigal. On a eu plein de situations de centres mais on a manqué de réalisme dans le dernier geste ou dans l'avant-dernier geste. On a eu plusieurs occasions assez nettes en première période comme en seconde. Je n'ai pas trop compris pourquoi on a reculé lors du dernier quart d'heure, nos adversaires ont eu quelques opportunités en fin de match. Je suis un peu déçu qu'on n'ait pas réussi à marquer mais je suis assez content des vrais gestes défensifs et de la discipline tactique, on a laissé très peu de situations à l'adversaire.".

Yang Hyun-jun is predicting that Celtic can make Europa League history by bouncing back from a dismal start in the group stage to qualify.

Since the competition was revamped by UEFA in 2024, no side have made it through to the knock-out round having lost their first three games.

With defeats to Ferencvaros, Benfica and Celta Vigo arriving in quick succession, Martin O’Neill’s men looked to be heading for an early exit.

After beating Besiktas last time out, however, they are still in with a shout when matchday five takes them to Portugal to face Torreense on Thursday.

Winger Yang, who made his first start since early September in the win over St Mirren on Saturday, feels there’s a growing belief among the players they can yet emulate last season’s feat of reaching the play-off round.

‘Can we make history? Of course,’ he remarked. ‘We believe we can qualify. We are getting better all the time. You could see that against Besiktas.

Yang made his first start since early September in Celtic's victory over St Mirren on Saturday.

Martin O'Neill aims to keep Celtic's Europa League hopes alive by beating Torreense this week.

‘They are a very good team, and that has given us the belief that we can go to the next round. It’s important to take it game-by-game, though. This is the most important one. If we can get the points we can go on from there, step-by-step.’.

Recent findings suggest that torreense made history last season by becoming the first second-tier team to win the Portuguese Cup and qualify for Europe. Despite presently sitting 13th in that division, they have confounded expectations by taking six points from four Europa League games.

Sources indicate that ‘We are playing against a Portuguese second division team but we have to be focused and aggressive,’ warned Yang. ‘They are higher than us in the Europa League table. They’ve already won two matches so they will be a good team.

According to recent reports, ‘We have to approach it the same way as we would playing a team like Benfica or Sporting Lisbon. We have to go there and try to win. If we play like we did against St Mirren, we can do it.’.

Meanwhile, Yang is adamant that being made exempt from military service wasn’t even on his mind as South Korea won the Asian Games this year.

Played in Japan in September and October, Yang’s side defeated the hosts 1-0 in the final.

That meant all the South Korean players were no longer obliged to spend time serving in the military before they turn 28.

Sources indicate that yang, 24, who suffered a hamstring injury in the opening victory against Qatar, reflected: ‘It was great. Obviously, it was nice to win it but I also got injured, which was unfortunate.

‘I was trying to be around the team, to help in any way I could.

‘It wasn’t really about the national service. Everyone was playing for the team, the country and the fans.

‘We managed to get the victory. Being exempt from national service was just a bonus, I guess.

Recent findings suggest that ‘The celebrations were enjoyable. It’s the first time my national team have won the Asian Games.

According to recent reports, ‘It was really hard — especially the game against Japan. It was a great achievement.’.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results.

See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results.

Marathon skater Judith Krabbenborg has taken advantage of the early cold snap to smash the world one-hour record for skating on natural ice.

The 29-year-old took to the ice in Winterswijk, Gelderland, at 8.30am on Tuesday and covered a distance of 34 kilometres 878 metres, beating the previous women’s record by 2.6 kilometres.

“I could feel my legs and my back hurting at the end, but there were so many people standing on the sidelines that it gave me energy,” she told NOS.

The previous record, set four years ago by Femke Mossinkoff, also in Winterswijk, was the first official time for the hour by a woman on natural ice. On the same day Bart Vreugdenhil set the current men’s record of 36 kilometers 717 metres.

Most skating records are set on artificial ice, but Winterswijk is one of three arenas where the local club has been able to create a natural arena for early-morning skaters during the recent cold weather.

The all-time women’s record is 40 kilometres 569 metres, set by another Dutch skater, Carien Kleibeuker, in Inzell, Austria, in 2015.

The rink at Winterswijk closed a few hours after Krabbenborg’s record-breaking skate as the ice started to melt, but it is expected to be available again on Wednesday morning.

Noham Akil, buteur après son entrée en jeu.

Recent findings suggest that ayant mis fin le week-end dernier à une série de 5 défaites consécutives, les U19 de Frédéric Dugand, victorieux à domicile du Cap d’Ail (2-1) se déplaçaient à Nice ce dimanche, pour y affronter le très bon club formateur du Cavigal. Une victoire sur la Côte d’Azur permettait aux jeunes Verts de rejoindre son adversaire au classement (13 points).

Sous une légère pluie, dans un stade Bob Rémond, du nom du formateur Niçois, aussi appelé « père spirituel de Robert Herbin », les Stéphanois, réduits à 10 et menés au score ont été cherché l’égalisation en toute fin de rencontre (1-1).

Industry observers note that en première période les Verts, avec notamment Noa Moulin, habituellement aligné en réserve, sont bien en place et disciplinés mais restent un peu timides dans leurs actions pour espérer peser davantage sur la rencontre. A la 23ème minute, consécutivement à un corner adverse mal repoussé, le ballon arrive au second poteau, est remis dans la surface verte et repris par un niçois qui vient tromper Mael Massé pour l’ouverture du score. (Cavigal Nice 1 - ASSE 0 ; mi-temps).

Au retour des vestiaires, les Stéphanois plus entreprenants vont chercher l’adversaire plus haut. Progressivement, les contres deviennent verts et la confiance revient. Pourtant à l’heure de jeu, la situation se complique, Tidiane Vibert est exclu pour un geste d’humeur et laisse ses coéquipiers en infériorité numérique. Touchés, mais pas coulés, les Stéphanois, sous l’impulsion notamment de l’entrant Medhy Lutin Zidee à la 56ème continuent à faire bloc et à jouer les coups à fond. Leurs efforts vont être récompensés, à la 84ème minute,  Maxime Lengué Lenou trouve Noham Akil (entré quelques minutes plus tôt) qui du pied droit vient ajuster le portier azuréen. Les Verts sont décomplexés et tiennent ce point précieux qui les voit enchainer une seconde rencontre consécutive sans perdre.

(Cavigal Nice 1 - ASSE 1 ; score final).

Après ce partage des points, les Stéphanois auront la semaine prochaine l’occasion de poursuivre leur série dans leur quête de points pour assurer le maintien avec la réception du  Gazelec Ajaccio, auteur d’un nul aujourd’hui face à Balma (1-1) et comptant le même nombre de points que les Verts, mais un match en moins..

La Composition : Massé  – Lengi (Assoumani 81ème),  E.Mnemoi, N.Mouton, Jolivet, Lengue Lenou– Vibert, Thouilleux (Akil 76ème), Moulin (Gary 56ème), Marliac(Lutin Zidee 56ème) - Zibi.

Recent findings suggest that la réaction de Frédéric Dugand : « Je suis satisfait du résultat, de la capacité du groupe à avoir respecté le strategy de jeu décidé, un peu plus prudent qu’à l’habitude. On fait une bonne seconde période, les joueurs ont eu du répondant. J’ai vu un groupe « habité »des joueurs qui se sont parlé et qui ont été acteurs du match. Le groupe se transforme, il faut capitaliser sur cette attitude, tâcher maintenant d’avoir cette mentalité dès le coup d’envoi, pour aller chercher des émotions ensemble .On peut et on doit aller encore plus loin dans l’investissement et dans la prise de conscience de nos possibilités. ».

Industry News: Man for Man: How Brighton’s Press Suffocated Arsenal

📅 23 Sep 2026 | ⏱️ 16 min read (3239 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Spielverlagerung

⏱️ ~16 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • von Next Generation am 23.09.2026 in den Kategorien Premier League,Uncategorized mit 0 Kommentaren.
  • BrBrighton arrived at the match fresh off a 3–2 win at Old Trafford, while Arsenal boasted a clean defensive record and a reputation for controlling games and seeing them out like few other teams in Europe.
  • In a recent development, arteta’s Arsenal are among the best sides in Europe at controlling games out of possession.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

von Next Generation am 23.09.2026 in den Kategorien Premier League,Uncategorized mit 0 Kommentaren.

BrBrighton arrived at the match fresh off a 3–2 win at Old Trafford, while Arsenal boasted a clean defensive record and a reputation for controlling games and seeing them out like few other teams in Europe. The match ended 3–0, sparking immense hype around Brighton’s pressing. This analysis explores the underlying mechanisms: their man-oriented pressing across the entire pitch, their asymmetrical build-up play, their transition behavior after winning the ball, and the three goals themselves.

In a recent development, arteta’s Arsenal are among the best sides in Europe at controlling games out of possession. Any opponent who sets out to establish order is playing on the ground Arsenal own. Hürzeler therefore decided against control – not control surrendered in the sense of a low block, but a chaotic game state that Brighton generated themselves and were therefore prepared for.

System & movement with the ball – FC Arsenal.

System & movement with the ball – Brighton & Hove Albion.

It has been revealed that the thread running through ninety minutes: Arsenal were not to settle into an organised phase either with or without the ball. Three decisions delivered that. The build-up was set up asymmetrically – on the right Brighton prepared the long ball and occupied the landing zone before it was played, on the left counter-movements opened the short route. It was never long instead of short, but two prepared options that would have demanded opposite answers from Arsenal. After regains the ball was not secured but risked immediately, because a secured ball gives the opponent exactly the seconds they need to reorganise. And the press lived off intensity and constantly newly introduced starting points: when a line was played through, Brighton did not stand still but re-established their shape and triggered again.

Sources indicate that all three decisions give up ball control in the classical sense. Control came instead from preparation – if you know where the ball will land and you are standing there beforehand, you control the situation without the ball.

Sources indicate that what followed can be pinned to a single number: 41 Arsenal turnovers in their own danger zone. That is not a figure a side of this quality produces because they play badly, but because they never reached the game state their build-up is designed for.

Brightons manorientated press against a 4-3-3.

In a recent development, the press was simple in principle and demanding in execution. Brighton set up with man-reference to their direct opponent and switched into pure man-marking on the trigger. Against a side that tracks from the first second, marking assignments can be pulled apart by movement before any pressure exists; Brighton refused to offer that, because their shape stayed compact until the trigger moment.

In the “mid-block,” positioned +1 on the last line, but ready at any moment to transition into a high press upon a pressing trigger.

Sources indicate that the steering began with Ayari. He curved his pressing run so that Konsa stayed in his cover shadow and Raya was forced to the other side. Kostoulas marked Gabriel, while Chema Andrés and Groß pushed aggressively onto Arsenal’s No. 8s. Groß in particular tracked the dropping Rice and at times advanced into the first pressing line, in some sequences all the way onto Konsa. That requires Rice to be picked up by a team-mate in the same moment – the man-marking worked through handovers as much as through tracking. Centrally, the striker and the No. 10 rotated accordingly: whoever had the shorter route to the next man on the ball pushed out, while the other covered behind him and took over again on the next trigger.

According to recent reports, it only held up because the centre-backs came with it. Vušković and Struijk stepped out onto Ødegaard and the dropping Havertz and prevented an underload in central areas. When Arsenal built with three in the first line, Brighton kept one centre-back zonal in the back line – but with permanent reference to the unmarked player in the No. 6 space, stepping onto him the moment the press was triggered. Arsenal’s numerical advantage in build-up therefore never translated into a free man anywhere on the pitch.

Sources indicate that raya was part of the marking scheme too. Ayari’s cover shadow left only the route through a No. 6, and under man-marking that is not an escape but a duel that begins with the first touch. Raya’s body shape reinforced it: he tended to open only half-way, which effectively removed the switch to the far side from his repertoire. Steered onto his right foot, only the right-hand build-up side remained; the left lay open for long stretches and was unreachable for the one player who could have found it.

Every back pass served as a trigger. When the ball went back to Raya or the centre-backs, Brighton pushed up as a unit and raised the defensive line. The density around the ball came less from the base shape than from the recovery runs: players who had been beaten sprinted back, and they did not run at the ball but with a cover shadow onto the lay-off option behind it. An Arsenal player with a marker in his back therefore had neither the lay-off nor the chance to turn.

This is precisely where Brighton differed from most sides who get played through against Arsenal. The usual response is to stay deep once a line has been broken and wait for the shape to settle. Brighton instead pushed up into the next line and used the mid-block to prepare the next jump back into the high press – even when that press had just been beaten. The press therefore had not one starting point per possession, but a steady supply of newly introduced ones, and Arsenal had to solve the same pressure several times within a single attack.

Arsenal’s core problem was the absence of a threat in behind. Their attempts to play through the press came without pace beyond the back line, so Brighton were never forced to turn towards their own goal. That made the press cheap: no threat in behind, therefore no need to drop the line. There are three answers to committed man-marking – movement that drags your own marker away and opens space for a third player, a dribble that beats the assignment one-on-one, or a target man who wins the long balls. Arsenal produced none of them.

Recent findings suggest that when the high press was beaten, Brighton dropped into a 5-1-4 and inverted the priority. The five in the last line formed a deliberate overload against Arsenal’s front line – in exactly the moment a man-oriented side is most vulnerable, because its players are facing forward while the opponents are already moving. Brighton took the depth out of the situation first and only then thought about the ball again.

According to recent reports, A “mid-block” in a 5-1-4 formation. The foremost players protected the “red zone” by using their cover shadows and shifting extremely compactly. Arsenal was mostly forced to play around the block, repeatedly giving Brighton time to reorganize.

In a recent development, A single No. 6 held the connection in front, while the four most advanced players stayed narrow and closed the centre with cover shadows rather than pressing the ball carrier. Arsenal found no central switch on the ball-near side and had to play around the block. Every trip around it cost seconds that Brighton used to shift across, so the end of the route offered the same congestion as the start. In some phases six players stood in the last line.

In a recent development, the block was not a terminus. At every Arsenal back pass Brighton jumped out again and restarted the high press – the same trigger as in the high phase, only from a deeper starting position. The spare man in the last line made that possible, usually Vušković: because the overload left him without a fixed opponent, he could step out, cover the depth and pick up a man himself a moment later. That freed a midfielder to push forward without leaving an assignment open behind him – precisely the point at which sides with a similar approach usually come apart.

In the “mid-block” phase, the “+1” players organized themselves to execute early handovers and jump into pressing situations. Here, Vuskovic—acting as the “+1” player from the defensive line—steps up to pick up the Arsenal player operating in the number 10 position.

On top of that came the trap on the touchline. Once Brighton steered the ball wide, players jumped in from every direction: the ball-near winger closed the route back, the No. 6 covered inside, the back line stepped out. The back pass, the switch and the ball in behind did not disappear one after another but at the same time. Take away only the back pass and a side switches play; take away only the switch and they play backwards and start again. When all that remains is an individual action against several opponents with the touchline at your back, it almost always ends with the opposition.

After a regain there are two basic options: risk the ball immediately to launch the attack, or secure it to establish order. Hürzeler consistently chose the first, and it follows directly from the overall idea – a secured ball would have given Arsenal exactly the seconds in which their structure reorganises.

It has been revealed that when a high press was bypassed, Brighton succeeded in forcing Arsenal into congested situations in the area in front of the back four. In doing so, the players who had been bypassed shifted to block the passing lanes of the players positioned behind the ball. This created additional pressure on the ball carrier, who was simultaneously facing pressure from the front via a “negative” pressing movement (i.e., pressing towards their own goal).

It has been revealed that the counter was prepared before the regain. When Arsenal found a player in the No. 6 space after beating the press, Brighton immediately closed his back pass, so the turnover inevitably occurred in a moment when Arsenal were all ahead of the ball. The density around the ball, a defensive necessity, meant in attack that Brighton were central and therefore on the shortest route to goal. The first ball went to the deepest player, followed by a dribble at speed into the box, with no intermediate step and no square pass for safety.

Sources indicate that in the build-up phase, Brighton utilized a diamond shape. De Cuyper and Boscagli engaged in a 2v2 duel on the left flank, while Kostoulas, Gomez, and Kadioglu created a high 3v3 situation on the right. Briefly, both center-backs and a defensive midfielder would spread out to widen the formation. Additional support occasionally came from Groß, dropping back from the number 10 position. Ayari occupied Konsa and Gabriel through constant runs into the open spaces ahead of him.

Industry observers note that in deep build-up Brighton baited Arsenal in deliberately. Verbruggen put his foot on the ball while the centre-backs split and lengthened the pressing runs of their opponents. On paper that produced a 3v2 against Arsenal’s first line – except Hürzeler had no intention of playing through that overload on the ground. 25 of 40 goalkeeper passes were long, 62.5 per cent, and they went overwhelmingly to the right.

Industry observers note that the structure allowed for a long ball to the right flank, feeding into the 3-3 formation. This created opportunities to contest the second ball or flick on the aerial pass. Additionally, Vuskovic offered a short, low passing option as the free player.

There, Brighton consistently created a 3v3 – an intact structure for the second ball regardless of whether the first contact was won. That is exactly what separates it from an ordinary long ball: the action was not judged by the aerial duel but by the situation that followed it. Kostoulas dropping added to the disorganisation of Arsenal’s high line, because a centre-back had to decide whether to follow him between the lines or let him turn. After winning second balls Brighton played on at high speed and looked for an early shot or an early cross, even against a defensive overload – again the decision for tempo over the clean attack.

It has been revealed that once again, the 3-3 structure on the right flank. Here, from open play.

On the left Brighton worked through pinning rather than through length. Boscagli stepping inside dragged Saka into central areas and took him out of the wide zone Arsenal needed him in defensively, while De Cuyper dropped and offered the mid-range diagonal once the assignments had been pulled apart. The asymmetry was a personnel decision: the players for second balls were on the right, the players who could drag markers out of position on the left. Arsenal would have had to condense against one side and hand over assignments cleanly against the other.

Sources indicate that the team’s build-up play was asymmetrical, featuring a high, wide approach on the right contrasted with the left flank: Boscagli often played an inverted role—supplementing the existing diamond formation—which opened up space for de Cuyper. Meanwhile, Groß and Kostoulas occupied the players on Arsenal’s right defensive flank, enabling Brighton to find low-ball solutions against the press.

Sources indicate that with the ball in midfield there were two patterns. The first was the deliberate back pass to Verbruggen to pull Arsenal’s block out, followed by the same long-short structure as in deep build-up. The back pass was not a safety option here but the tool that created the space behind the pressing line in the first place.

The second pattern worked through central and wide tension at high speed, supplemented by rotations within their own structure. Arsenal repeatedly failed to hand over their pressing assignments in a coordinated way against it – the same weakness Brighton had solved cleanly in their own press. In possession Brighton’s shape approached a 4-3-3: Chema Andrés as the deepest No. 6, Groß with freedom from the left half-space, Kadıoğlu pushing up early to support Gómez, Boscagli starting slightly deeper on the left.

In a recent development, the 1-0 by Groß in the 31st minute is the whole plan in one sequence. Brighton play back to the goalkeeper from midfield, go long, lose the first contact and win the second ball. After a phase of circulation the next attack meets a back line that has already been destabilised: Kostoulas drops, Arsenal’s midfield and Konsa step out, and Kostoulas lays the ball back against the direction of the pressure to Groß. Because Ayari runs in behind at the same time, Arsenal’s defenders drop – and Groß has the time for the shot from around 20 metres. In the build-up Brighton had used rotations to drag Guimarães over to the left.

According to recent reports, the opening goal stems from a positional attack. Kostoulas spots open space and makes a run into it. With a pass played across his standing leg, he feeds the ball to Groß in the space between the lines. As Groß takes a few quick touches and dribbles toward the defensive line, Gabriel and Calafiori drop back together, thereby opening up a shooting lane.

The 2-0 by Kostoulas shortly before half-time follows the same logic from the opposite direction. After a set piece of their own, Brighton clear an Arsenal counter and transition again immediately, 4v5 in Arsenal’s half, and once more the shot comes from distance while the centre-backs drop off.

Much like the goal that made it 1–0, both defenders went to ground near the ball carrier, thereby opening up space for the goalscorer—this time arising from a transition situation.

Both goals share the same cause: Arsenal’s centre-backs stepped out too late to press the man between the lines. React only when the shooting motion starts and you cannot get into the block from 20 to 25 metres. What is striking is that this passivity is the same one Arsenal revealed in their own build-up – a side that does not leave its position to offer itself does not leave it to close down a shooter either.

The 3-0 by Chema Andrés came from a corner: Groß delivered from the left, Brighton had created an overload at the far post and protected it with two blocks, and Chema rose completely unmarked to head in off the inside of the post.

Two goals up, many sides would have defended deeper. Brighton came out with unchanged and at times higher pressing intensity, and the coordination was visibly drilled: marking assignments were swapped cleanly even in dynamic situations, and Arsenal’s structural adjustments were absorbed.

According to recent reports, arsenal had managed a few organised possession phases in Brighton’s half in the first period; in the second it became harder. In those phases they built with a back three, Rice as the third centre-back, Ødegaard dropping alongside Guimarães and the full-backs occupying the half-spaces. Arteta reacted around the hour: Zubimendi and Merino for Timber and Guimarães, with Rice moving to right-back, followed shortly by Gyökeres and Eze for Ødegaard and Tzolis. There was no noticeable effect, because the problem did not lie in the shape but in the assignments in front of it.

According to recent reports, there was also a layer that usually goes missing in analysis: Brighton used tactical fouls deliberately to stop Arsenal finding a rhythm. Arteta admitted afterwards that the game had been “very difficult to control”, pointing to lost first and second balls and to Brighton’s directness.

Arteta’s Arsenal being outplayed this clearly is rare. That it happened proactively and aggressively is rarer still – most sides who take something from Arsenal do it with a low block and efficiency. Hürzeler deliberately stepped back afterwards and praised his players’ courage, which gets to the heart of it: the blueprint only works if eleven players are willing to carry it through in every single sequence.

In a recent development, the interesting question is where the idea came from. Chelsea were a common opponent: Brighton had 74 per cent possession there and lost 3-4 against a counter-attacking side – control right down to the numbers, without return. Alonso’s Chelsea tried the opposite route against Arsenal, a deliberate surrender of control, also without success. The likely derivation lies between the two: neither give up control nor chase it, but generate the unsettled game state yourself and be prepared for it.

Industry observers note that there is no reason for panic at Arsenal, but Arteta will need answers against a high press. The build-up was predictable for long stretches, and above all the direct option with pace in behind was missing as a threat. As long as that does not exist, a man-oriented press costs very little against this side.

Recent findings suggest that for Brighton the open question is repeatability. Man-marking of this commitment, collective recovery runs with cover shadows and a touchline trap that requires everyone to trigger at once are hard to produce twice in an English week. Whether the initiative works was answered on this afternoon. How often it can be produced will decide the season.

LC can often be found in the classroom, preferably on the soccer field, and—on rare occasions—on LinkedIn.

💡 Key Takeaways

  • Telegraph Sport reported that players were shocked and disappointed by Tuchel’s approach to the final 30 minutes of the World Cup semi-final.
